title: RNA extraction from Sterivex filters for metatranscriptomics in aquatic microbiomes
author: Viviana Fonti

steps.title: Prepare Sterivex Cartridge
steps.instruction: Prepare the Sterivex cartridge for disassembly and ensure reagents are ready.

substeps.instruction: Place 5 mL PowerWater bead tubes on ice.
Ensure DNA/RNA Shield is completely thawed.
Hold the Sterivex cartridge with the vent end facing upward and remove the parafilm or seal from the vent, keeping the Luer-lock inlet sealed.

steps.title: Extract Filter Membrane
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the filter membrane and DNA/RNA Shield from the Sterivex cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Use pliers to press just beneath the sealed circumference near the vent end, rotating the cartridge until the inner cylinder pops loose.
Place a Petri dish beneath the Sterivex to collect any leaking DNA/RNA Shield or filter pieces.
Use a sterile blade to locate the membrane seam (vertical plastic strip) and make two parallel cuts along each side and cuts along the horizontal edges to fully detach the filter membrane.
Use pliers to lift the inner cylinder by the vent end and pour the DNA/RNA Shield into a 5 mL PowerWater bead tube.
Use tweezers to peel the filter from the cylinder and place it into the same 5 mL PowerWater bead tube; collect all pieces if the filter breaks.

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis of the sample using bead beating.

substeps.instruction: Under a chemical fume hood, add 10 µL of β-Mercaptoethanol directly to the bead tube and securely tighten the screw cap.
Place bead tubes horizontally in a Vortex adapter and vortex at maximum speed for 5 min.

steps.title: Supernatant Recovery and Initial Purification
steps.instruction: Recover the supernatant and perform an initial cleanup step.

substeps.instruction: Draw up the supernatant using a 1 mL pipette tip (expecting 1500–1700 µL) and transfer it to a clean 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube.
Add 200 µL of Solution IRS, vortex briefly to mix, and incubate at 2–8°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min.
Carefully collect the supernatant (avoiding solid fragments or floating clumps) and transfer it to a clean 15 mL Falcon-like tube.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Column Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the recovered supernatant for RNA binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 1300 µL of Solution PM3 and 1300 µL of Solution PM4 to the sample and vortex briefly to mix.
Add 2 volumes (100 µL) of RNA Binding Buffer and mix.
Add an equal volume (150 µL) of ethanol (95-100%) and mix.

steps.title: RNA Purification via Zymo-Spin Column
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using the Zymo-Spin™ IC Column sequence.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to the Zymo-Spin™ IC Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min; discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL RNA Prep Buffer, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through.
Transfer the column into an RNase-free tube.
Add 15 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: RNA Purification via MB RNA Spin Column
steps.instruction: Perform an alternative or additional purification using the MB RNA Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µL of supernatant onto an MB RNA Spin Column, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through; repeat until all supernatant is loaded.
Add 650 µL of Solution PM5, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through.
Add 650 µL of Solution PM4, centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min, and discard flow-through.
Centrifuge again at 13,000 × g for 2 min and discard flow-through.
Place the MB RNA Spin Column into a clean 2 mL collection tube.
Add 50 µL of RNase-free water to the center of the column membrane, wait 1 min, and centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min.
Reload the 50 µL of eluate to the center of the column membrane, wait 1 min, and centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 1 min; discard the column.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of DNase I Solution to the center of the column membrane and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Add 400 µL of Solution PM7 and centrifuge the column at 13,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Measure RNA yield and store samples.

substeps.instruction: Measure 1 µL of extracted RNA with a Nanodrop Spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Measure 2 µL of extracted RNA with a Qubit RNA HS assay (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Store the samples at -80°C.
